idea-plugin.name: GitButler for IDE
idea-plugin.description:
Adds GitButler virtual-branch support to the IntelliJ commit window, letting you assign changes to virtual branches without leaving the IDE.

This is an unofficial plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitButler. The GitButler mark is used under its CC0-1.0 brand assets (github.com/gitbutlerapp/gitbutler-brand-assets).

action.description: Select the GitButler virtual branch to commit to
